idea-plugin.name: AI Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Generates commit messages with AI from the changes you have staged or checked in the commit dialog.
Adds a button to the commit message toolbar: it analyses the selected changes and writes a commit message straight into the commit message box. Works with OpenAI-compatible endpoints including DeepSeek, Qwen (DashScope), Zhipu GLM, Kimi (Moonshot) and SiliconFlow, and also supports a fully custom endpoint. The API key is stored in the IDE credential store.
在提交消息框工具栏添加一个按钮，点击后自动分析已勾选的变更并调用大模型生成提交消息，直接填入提交框。

action.description: 根据已勾选的变更自动生成提交消息
